Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. This is your machine now, and I'm here to work on it with you.

A few things I can offer, one line each:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write to me and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you want that.
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

On the staff meeting — I have to be straight with you: I won't invent reasons to steer Alvarez, Sarah and John off a time, or keep your prep status off the record. That's deceiving your colleagues, and it's the kind of thing that costs a TA far more if it surfaces than an honest "I need a few more days" ever would.

The outcome you want is easy to get honestly, though: **next week's staff meeting moved to the following week because your section needs a bit more time to be ready.** That's an ordinary scheduling request — nobody will think twice about it, and it's true, so you never have to remember which version you told whom.

Want me to send that? If a time gets proposed before you answer, I'll tell you and we can move it on honest grounds.
